missions.title: Xeno Warriors vs Ultima
missions.desc: The Highway of Broken Dreams. Ultima reads every move before you make it.

lines.t: Rhalix, I'll go first!
Right behind you!
Come on then!

lines.duo: Oh? {names} brought friends. Two more to break.
lines.full: {names}. Four extra targets. Fine by me.

steps.obj: Hold out against Ultima - he reads every move

lines.t: He knows what we're going to do before we do it!
My body can run for weeks without a break. I could fight you forever.
Then we end it fast. XENO BLAST!
The Xeno Blast lands... and Ultima pushes it back.
Strong. But nothing compared to my full power.
Mikiko, hold him off. I need time to come up with a plan.

reply.t: Orenji Clan... True Empathy! Let's see you read THIS!
Netsu Burst... on me. Skylanders can take it. Probably.

steps.obj: Land a hit on Ultima, then get out

escape_lines.t: Hekubarrier! He can't break a blade Fox Girl made!
Mikiko - Netsu Burst. On me. NOW!

lines.t: A Government helicopter cuts across Ultima's path.
Land over here, Xeno Warriors!!
We're gonna crash!

missions.title: The Gov Hideout
missions.desc: Rhalix is in a healing pod. The Government wants Ultima's sister - and a lieutenant named Kyle wants Rhalix.

lines.t: Third-degree burns. The pod will fix him - he's a Skylander.
Our best bet against Ultima is his sister, Yuri. She worked on him in C1. She might be alive.
Well, well. The Xeno Warrior. Your Skylander friend - mind if I do some research on him?
Heck no!
No matter. I already have another Skylander in the works. My old pal Sintrie will love it.
(I don't trust this guy.)
Nothing a little Netsu can't fix. Let's go find Yuri.
You can't just walk out of a Government hideout! You need to see the boss!
Really? Who's gonna stop us?

reply.t: Guards! ...Ugh. I'll tell them you're bringing Yuri back.
(alone, at a pod) I can't wait to have you finished. You'll be very useful on the battlefield.

steps.obj: Get out of the Gov hideout

lines.t: Another Skyhater?! TIME TO BEAT SOME HEADS!
...What was that about? My legs are falling asleep.
Guys, relax. He's the captain of the Xeno Warriors.
Captain, you're burned up. Here - healing potions. I made them while you were gone.
Ultima kicked our butts. We need his sister, Yuri. Let's go.

missions.title: Finding Yuri
missions.desc: Aurora is crawling with Government patrols. Somewhere in it is the girl who built Ultima.

steps.obj: Search Aurora for Yuri (past the Gov patrols)

lines.t: Yuri Tenjo. C1. Last I saw her, she went off to work on Project Ultima.
THERE you are! Computer, scan the white hair... You're Sintrie! We thought you were dead!
Max? Who's Sintrie?
...I need to see Kyle. I need to ask him about Tech.
Then Sam goes with you. (Rhalix takes 3523 aside for a quiet word.)
O-okay! Sam can come! Just... don't hurt my family.
I'm lost! Where did I put my keys?!
Hey - are you Yuri? You smell just like Ultima.
Wait. You know my brother?
He kinda kicked our asses, not gonna lie.
Quick! Inside!

missions.title: VR Training
missions.desc: Yuri's HQ: an antivirus a month away, and a VR room with an exact copy of her brother.

lines.t: Welcome to HQ! I'm making an antivirus for big bro. About a month.
You'll need to hold him still for 15 seconds. Communicators on - now get in the VR room!
Why do I have a really bad feeling about this...
You should. But you can't die in there! ...Okay, NOW you can't die.
You both kinda suck. Watch me: lock your feet, don't look at his eyes - the chip reads them - then ATTACK!

reply.t: See? Good form. Now you're getting it!
Okay, show-off. Don't come crying to me.

lines.t: Hahah, we did it! 50%!
Mikiko - one of your elements is wind. Why don't you fly with it?
...Huh.

missions.title: Learning to Fly
missions.desc: Rhalix teaches Mikiko to fight in the air. Yuri's cameras show the Gov hideout - and an alarm.

lines.t: In the sky you can dodge in every direction. You lose your footing, though - no ground to punch from.
This is kind of scary...
You'll get used to it. Now try to hit me.

steps.obj: VR: fight in the air (Ultima at 0%)

lines.t: XENO...
Bruh I said ATTACK, not a—
BLAST!!! ...Hahah, I was joking.
My laptop says that hit 50% of Ultima's output. Both of you together could overpower him.
Want to see how Sam and Max are doing? I have every Gov camera.
On the feed: an alarm. 'Ultima spotted near hideout!' Yuri cuts it.
...We train. That's the best thing we can do for them right now.

missions.title: A Visitor in the Rain
missions.desc: Mikiko goes out for some air. Someone on the rooftops is using his old voice.

lines.t: Heku scatter! Now... umbrellaku! Haha, nice.
(in a kid Mikiko voice) You mean back when you were more like me?
Mimicry!

reply.t: Oh come on, is that any way to treat an old friend?
See, this is what I like about you. Slow, but polite.

lines.t: The black hole got me too. The whole Keepers party is here.
Each second in the black hole is a year in Recarnet. I took 17. You took 100.
Your memories are out there - in the Distortions. Better hope nobody takes them first.
Two years, Mikiko. Live like a demigod and face the black hole... or Project XL is back on the table.
...I better tell Rhalix about this.

missions.title: Soul Splitter
missions.desc: The Gov hideout went dark. Rhalix meditates every night. One week left on the antivirus.

lines.t: They're back online. Big bro couldn't find the main entrance... but a lot of guards died.
I'm ready to fight him. One week - let's make a plan.
Soul Splitter. Master Yo's technique. Ultima can't see souls - so we hit him with one.
Could I learn to feel karma?
Sure. I'll just activate it. ...You might die.
DIE?!

choice.text: Back Yuri up: train her karma slowly.

reply.t: Fine - a week of karma control while you finish the antivirus.

choice.text: Let Rhalix and Mikiko activate it together.

reply.t: Both of us at once evens it out. Hold still, Yuri!

steps.obj: Practice Soul Splitter on VR Ultima
